title.narrative: Humanitarian mine action in Yemen NL MFA 2020-2024

description.narrative: The target groups for this project are communities suffering from the threat of landmines and other explosive remnants of war in Ta'iz governorate in Yemen.

This project aims to safe lives and increase livelihoods in Yemen and improve access to resources, essential services and socio-economic opportunities by: 1) clearing landmines and other explosive items, 2) providing Explosive Ordnance Risk Education, 3) conducting survey, 4) conduct explosive ordnance disposal (EOD)
